### Register entity repository in UsersModule with TypeOrmModule.forFeature() Source: https://github.com/nestjs/docs.nestjs.com/blob/master/content/data/typeorm.md Uses TypeOrmModule.forFeature() to define which repositories are registered within the current module's scope. ```typescript @@filename(users.module) import { Module } from '@nestjs/common'; import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm'; import { UsersService } from './users.service.js'; import { UsersController } from './users.controller.js'; import { User } from './user.entity.js'; @Module({ imports: [TypeOrmModule.forFeature([User])], providers: [UsersService], controllers: [UsersController], }) export class UsersModule {} ``` -------------------------------- ### Register entity in AppModule with TypeOrmModule.forRoot() Source: https://github.com/nestjs/docs.nestjs.com/blob/master/content/data/typeorm.md Adds the User entity to the entities array in TypeOrmModule.forRoot options to make TypeORM aware of the entity. ```typescript @@filename(app.module) import { Module } from '@nestjs/common'; import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm'; import { User } from './users/user.entity.js'; @Module({ imports: [ TypeOrmModule.forRoot({ type: 'mysql', host: 'localhost', port: 3306, username: 'root', password: 'root', database: 'test', entities: [User], synchronize: true, }), ], }) export class AppModule {} ``` -------------------------------- ### Re-export TypeOrmModule from UsersModule Source: https://github.com/nestjs/docs.nestjs.com/blob/master/content/data/typeorm.md Re-exports TypeOrmModule to allow external modules that import UsersModule to access its generated repository providers. ```typescript @@filename(users.module) import { Module } from '@nestjs/common'; import { TypeOrmModule } from '@nestjs/typeorm'; import { User } from './user.entity.js'; @Module({ imports: [TypeOrmModule.forFeature([User])], exports: [TypeOrmModule] }) export class UsersModule {} ``` ### Repositories Source: https://github.com/nestjs/docs.nestjs.com/blob/master/content/data/mikroorm.md To define which repositories are registered in the current scope, use the `forFeature()` method: > info **Note** Don't register your base entities via `forFeature()`, as there are no repositories for them. Base entities do, however, need to be part of the ORM configuration (e.g., the `entities` option of `forRoot()`). Then import the `PhotoModule` into the root `AppModule`: -------------------------------- ### TypeORM Source: https://github.com/nestjs/docs.nestjs.com/blob/master/content/data/typeorm.md The `forRoot()` method accepts all the configuration properties supported by the TypeORM [`DataSource` constructor](https://typeorm.io/docs/data-source/data-source-options#common-data-source-options). It also accepts the following extra properties:
retryAttempts Number of attempts to connect to the database (default: 10)
retryDelay Delay between connection retry attempts, in milliseconds (default: 3000)
toRetry Function that receives the connection error and returns whether to retry. By default, every error is retried
verboseRetryLog If true, the error message is included in the log entry for each connection retry (default: false)
autoLoadEntities If true, entities are loaded automatically (default: false). See Auto-load entities
manualInitialization If true, the data source isn't initialized during module initialization, so no connection is established and no migrations run. You must call DataSource.initialize() yourself and handle retries if needed (default: false)
> info **Hint** Learn more about the available options in the [TypeORM data source options](https://typeorm.io/docs/data-source/data-source-options) documentation.
